name: sum_coeff_eq_coeff_sum
statement: Type*} {S : Finset α} (x : α → 𝕎 R) (h : ∀ (n : ℕ), Subsingleton {r | r ∈ S ∧ (x r).coeff n ≠ 0}) (n : ℕ) : (∑ s ∈ S, x s).coeff n = ∑ (s ∈ S), (x s).coeff n

have_tree.type: (∀ (n : ℕ), Subsingleton {r | r ∈ S' ∧ (x r).coeff n ≠ 0})
∀ (n : ℕ), (x a).coeff n = 0 ∨ (∑ s ∈ S', x s).coeff n = 0
